name: Fey Touched
summary: +1 Int, Wis or Cha; Misty Step and a level 1 Divination or Enchantment spell, each free once per Long Rest.

benefits.name: Fey Magic
benefits.summary: Misty Step and a level 1 Divination or Enchantment spell are always prepared; each is free once per Long Rest.
benefits.text: Choose one level 1 spell from the Divination or Enchantment school. You always have that spell and Misty Step prepared. You can cast each of them once without a spell slot, regaining the free casting of each when you finish a Long Rest, and you can also cast them using spell slots of the appropriate level. Their spellcasting ability is the ability you increased with this feat.

choice.label: Fey Magic: your level 1 Divination or Enchantment spell (Misty Step comes with the feat)
